step_1500_discrepancy_explanation.root_cause: The 500-step scheduler pilot (Arm B) was configured with warmup_steps=50, reaching cosine decay by step 1500. In contrast, the 4,000-step main continuation (steps 1000 -> 5000) was configured with warmup_steps=200 and a 4,000-step decay horizon. At step 1500 (300 steps into decay), the effective learning rate in the main run was ~0.000493 vs ~0.000475 in the pilot, yielding slightly different parameter trajectories. Both paths were deterministic and internally consistent with their respective hyperparameter declarations.
